# Overview

I analyzed GrowthProfiler growth curves of heterologous variants of
*Saccharomyces cerevisiae* IMK1010 (a strain lacking most native hexose
transporters and disaccharide hydrolases) and IMK1010-MSM (able to
catabolize mannitol and sorbitol) to characterize substrate utilization
following introduction of heterologous fungal sugar transporters. The genes
of interest (GOI) are anonymized as GOI01, GOI02, ... in this public version.
Every transporter is fused to yPet; the empty vector expresses free yPet.

**Strains**

IMK1010 background with pUDE453 vector:

- **Empty vector (EV)** — no gene of interest (GOI).
- **GOI01–GOI07** — heterologous fungal sugar transporters.
- **hxt5** — positive control.

IMK1010-MSM background with pUDE453 vector:

- **Empty vector (EV)** — no gene of interest (GOI).
- **GOI03, GOI04** — heterologous fungal sugar transporters.
- **AnManSorST** — confirmed positive control.

Two further transporters were discarded because they did not localize to the
plasma membrane.

**Substrates and concentrations (IMK1010 strains):** 5 substrates
(ethanol, glucose, fructose, galactose, mannose) at 0.2% and 2% w/v,
plus glucose and fructose at 8% and glucose at 0.5%.
Ethanol was only tested at 2%.

**Substrates and concentrations (IMK1010-MSM strains):**
3 substrates (ethanol, mannitol, sorbitol) at 0.5%, 1% and 2% w/v.
Ethanol was only tested at 2%.

**Note:** Only the strains that showed growth are shown in the figures.

## How to read this report

| Section | Question it answers | Files |
|---|---|---|
| 3.1 Growth calls | Which strain grows on which substrate? | `report_and_figures/growth_calls.pdf` |
| 3.2 Performance overview | How fast and how far does each strain grow, compared across all conditions? | `report_and_figures/overview.pdf` |
| 3.3 yPet expression on ethanol | Are the transporters expressed, compared on one plate? | `report_and_figures/ypet_ethanol.pdf` |
| 3.4 Substrate pages | Per substrate: all strains side by side, five growth parameters + transporter expression + growth curves | `report_and_figures/substrate_pages.pdf` |
| 3.5 Parameter table | The numbers behind every figure | `tables/*.csv` |
| Appendix | Quality check of every well and of µmax | `report_and_figures/qc_wells.pdf` |

Every figure set is also saved as one SVG per page (editable text) in a
folder of the same name, except the quality checks (PDF only).

# Data and methods

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(growthrates)  # model-free µmax ("easylinear", Hall et al. 2014)
library(patchwork)    # multi-panel pages
library(ggh4x)        # fixed panel sizes
library(ggpubr)       # theme_pubr
library(svglite)      # SVG export with editable text
library(knitr)
```

## Analysis parameters

`selected_strains` and `selected_conditions` define which wells are
analysed; everything else in the report follows from them.

```{r analysis-parameters}
# --- Selected strains and goi ---------------------------------------------
# Only strains that showed growth in at least one condition are shown.

selected_strains <- data.frame(host_strain= c("IMK1010", "IMK1010",  "IMK1010",
                                              "IMK1010", "IMK1010", "IMK1010",
                                              "IMK1010", "IMK1010", "IMK1010",
                                              "IMK1010-MSM", "IMK1010-MSM",
                                              "IMK1010-MSM", "IMK1010-MSM"),
                               goi= c("EV", "GOI01", "GOI02",
                                      "GOI03", "GOI04", "GOI05",
                                      "GOI06", "GOI07", "hxt5",
                                      "EV", "GOI03", "GOI04", "AnManSorST")) %>%
  filter(host_strain %in% c("IMK1010", "IMK1010-MSM"),
         goi %in% c("EV", "GOI03", "GOI04", "GOI05", "GOI07", "hxt5", "AnManSorST"))

selected_conditions <- data.frame(substrate = c("ethanol",
                                                 "glucose",  "glucose", "glucose",
                                                 "fructose", "fructose", "fructose",
                                                 "galactose", "galactose",
                                                 "mannose", "mannose",
                                                 "mannitol", "mannitol", "mannitol",
                                                 "sorbitol", "sorbitol", "sorbitol"),
                               concentration= c("2.00%",
                                                "0.20%", "2.00%", "8.00%",
                                                "0.20%", "2.00%", "8.00%",
                                                "0.20%", "2.00%",
                                                "0.20%", "2.00%",
                                                "0.50%", "1.00%", "2.00%",
                                                "0.50%", "1.00%", "2.00%"))

# Positive control GOI per host strain
POSITIVE_CONTROL <- c("IMK1010" = "hxt5", "IMK1010-MSM" = "AnManSorST")

# --- Data processing ------------------------------------------------------
MAX_TIME_H  <- 150.1  # time points after this (h) are dropped
SMOOTH_K    <- 9      # rolling-median window for OD_smooth, in time points (1 point = 1 h); odd
GROWTH_OD   <- 1      # a well "grows" if its smoothed OD reaches this; also "time to OD"
MU_MIN_OD   <- 1      # growth rates use only OD >= this (see Methods)
MU_WINDOW   <- 5      # sliding window for growth rates, in time points (5 h)
MU_FRACTION <- 0.5    # deceleration = growth rate falls below this fraction of µmax

# --- yPet fluorescence (end point, one Spark file per plate) ----------------
YPET_RANGE  <- "A88:M95"  # 2nd reading (TF_GFP, ex 485 / em 530): plate rows A-H x columns 1-12

# --- Output ---------------------------------------------------------------
FIG_DIR   <- "report_and_figures"   # PDFs and SVGs (the knitted HTML goes here too)
TABLE_DIR <- "tables"               # CSV tables
```

## Data

```{r load-metadata}
project_dir <- getwd()
data_dir    <- file.path(project_dir,"raw_data")

growthprofiler_md <- read_table(file.path(data_dir, "growthprofiler_MD.tsv")) %>%
  filter(host_strain!="empty") %>%
  inner_join(selected_conditions) %>%
  inner_join(selected_strains)
```

```{r load-growth-data}
data_clean_up <- function(plate_id) {
  file_name <- paste0(plate_id, "_OD.csv")
  file_path <- file.path(data_dir, "growth_profiler", file_name)

  if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
    stop("File not found: ", file_path)
  }

  raw_data <- read.csv(file_path, check.names = TRUE, skip = 33) %>%
    rename("time_min"='Time..min.') %>%
    select(-c("X","Input_Image")) %>%
    mutate(time_h = time_min / 60) # Convert minutes -> decimal hours

  # Pivot wide -> long, join metadata
  long_data <- raw_data %>%
    dplyr::select(-time_min) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols      = -time_h,
      names_to  = "well",
      values_to = "OD_gp"
    ) %>%
    mutate(plate_id = plate_id) %>%
    inner_join(growthprofiler_md, by = c("plate_id", "well")) %>%   # drops empty wells
    filter(!is.na(host_strain))                        # just to be sure to remove wells we missed with the empty label

  return(long_data)
}

# Load all runs and stack
run_ids <- unique(growthprofiler_md$plate_id)
growth_data_raw <- map_dfr(run_ids, data_clean_up)

# Final OD per well, for the fluorescence ratio: median of the last SMOOTH_K
# readings of the whole run (fluorescence was read right after the run, so
# this uses the time points after MAX_TIME_H too)
final_od <- growth_data_raw %>%
  group_by(plate_id, well) %>%
  arrange(time_h, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  summarise(final_od = median(tail(OD_gp, SMOOTH_K)), .groups = "drop")

# Per well: OD_smooth = rolling median of the raw OD; OD_bg = raw OD minus its
# minimum (used for the AUC)
growth_data_all <- growth_data_raw %>%
  filter(time_h <= MAX_TIME_H) %>%
  group_by(plate_id, well) %>%
  arrange(time_h, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(OD_smooth = runmed(OD_gp, k = SMOOTH_K, endrule = "median"),
         OD_bg     = OD_gp - min(OD_gp)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(plate = str_extract(plate_id, "MTP\\d+"))

# Mean ± SD curve per strain x condition (for the growth-curve panels)
growth_data_mean <- growth_data_all %>%
  group_by(host_strain, goi, substrate, concentration, time_h) %>%
  summarise(mean_OD = mean(OD_smooth), stdev_OD = sd(OD_smooth), .groups = "drop")
```

yPet fluorescence was read once per plate, right after the run, on a Tecan
Spark. Only the second reading (TF_GFP, ex 485 / em 530) is used. The first
reading (ex 510 / em 540) has a background of 35,000–55,000 even in EV wells
and saturates, so it cannot separate yPet from background. Saturated wells
("OVER") are left empty.

```{r load-ypet}
# One header row of the TF_GFP block, as text (row 67 = name, row 74 = gain)
read_header_row <- function(file, row) {
  readxl::read_excel(file, range = paste0("A", row, ":M", row), col_names = FALSE,
                     col_types = "text", .name_repair = "minimal") %>%
    unlist()
}

read_ypet <- function(file) {
  stopifnot("TF_GFP" %in% read_header_row(file, 67))   # YPET_RANGE must be the TF_GFP reading
  gain <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(read_header_row(file, 74))) %>% na.omit() %>% first()
  readxl::read_excel(file, range = YPET_RANGE, col_names = c("row", 1:12), col_types = "text") %>%
    pivot_longer(-row, names_to = "column", values_to = "ypet_raw") %>%
    transmute(plate = str_extract(basename(file), "MTP\\d+"),
              well  = paste0(row, column),
              ypet  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ypet_raw)),   # "OVER" (saturated) -> NA
              gain  = gain)
}

ypet_data <- list.files(file.path(data_dir, "yPET_fluorescence"), pattern = "\\.xlsx$",
                        full.names = TRUE) %>%
  map_dfr(read_ypet)

ypet_gain_text <- ypet_data %>%
  distinct(plate, gain) %>%
  arrange(plate) %>%
  with(paste(plate, gain, collapse = ", "))
```

```{r figure-settings}
# Strain order everywhere: EV, transporters, positive control.
# Colours: controls grey (EV light, positive controls dark), transporters
# Okabe-Ito (colour-blind safe). Each GOI has the same colour in both hosts.
transporters <- setdiff(unique(selected_strains$goi), c("EV", POSITIVE_CONTROL))
goi_levels   <- c("EV", transporters, unique(POSITIVE_CONTROL))
okabe_ito    <- unname(palette.colors(palette = "Okabe-Ito")[c(6, 7, 4, 8, 2, 3, 5)])
goi_colors   <- c(EV = "grey65",
                  setNames(okabe_ito[seq_along(transporters)], transporters),
                  setNames(rep("grey20", length(unique(POSITIVE_CONTROL))), unique(POSITIVE_CONTROL)))
goi_labels   <- setNames(goi_levels, goi_levels)
goi_labels["EV"] <- "EV (- ctrl)"
goi_labels[unique(POSITIVE_CONTROL)] <- paste(unique(POSITIVE_CONTROL), "(+ ctrl)")

host_gois <- function(strain) {
  intersect(goi_levels, selected_strains$goi[selected_strains$host_strain == strain])
}

theme_gp <- theme_pubr(base_size = 10)

# File-name label, e.g. "IMK1010_glucose"
plot_name <- function(...) {
  paste(..., sep = "_") %>%
    str_replace_all("%", "pct") %>%
    str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_")
}

# Draw a ggplot, or a page that was already laid out as a grob
draw_plot <- function(p) {
  if (is.ggplot(p)) print(p) else { grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(p) }
}

# Write a named list of plots as one multi-page PDF (+ one SVG per plot)
export_plots <- function(plots, set_name, width = 11, height = 8.5, svg = TRUE) {
  dir.create(FIG_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)
  pdf(file.path(FIG_DIR, paste0(set_name, ".pdf")), width = width, height = height)
  tryCatch(for (p in plots) draw_plot(p), finally = dev.off())   # always close the PDF
  if (svg) {
    svg_dir <- file.path(FIG_DIR, set_name)
    dir.create(svg_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
    for (nm in names(plots)) {
      ggsave(file.path(svg_dir, paste0(nm, ".svg")), plots[[nm]],
             width = width, height = height, device = svglite::svglite)
    }
  }
  invisible(plots)
}

# Print a named list of plots as tabs in the HTML report (chunk needs results='asis')
show_plots <- function(plots) {
  for (nm in names(plots)) {
    tab_title <- nm %>% str_replace_all("pct", "%") %>% str_replace_all("_", " ")
    cat("\n\n### ", tab_title, " {.unlisted .unnumbered}\n\n", sep = "")
    draw_plot(plots[[nm]])
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

**`r nrow(growthprofiler_md)` wells** on `r n_distinct(growthprofiler_md$plate_id)`
plates, 3 replicate wells per strain × condition. All replicate wells of a
strain × condition are on the same plate, so they show the well-to-well
spread, not the plate-to-plate spread.

**Plate layout.** Strains are compared on the same plate except for the
positive control hxt5, which was grown on other plates than the transporters
for glucose, fructose, galactose and mannose. Differences between hxt5 and the
transporters on those substrates may partly be plate effects. For yPet
fluorescence the plates differ even more: the reader set its gain
automatically per plate (`r ypet_gain_text`), so fluorescence values are
comparable only within a plate. The substrate pages repeat this warning where
it applies.

```{r plate-layout}
growthprofiler_md %>%
  mutate(plate = str_extract(plate_id, "MTP\\d+"),
         goi   = factor(goi, goi_levels)) %>%
  group_by(host_strain, substrate, goi) %>%
  summarise(plate = paste(sort(unique(plate)), collapse = " + "), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(goi) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = goi, values_from = plate, values_fill = "") %>%
  arrange(host_strain, substrate) %>%
  kable(caption = "Plate of each strain × substrate")
```

## Growth parameters

Five growth parameters are calculated for **every well** directly from its
curve (no growth model), plus its yPet fluorescence per OD, then averaged per
strain × condition. A well whose smoothed OD
never reaches **OD `r GROWTH_OD`** counts as **no growth (n.g.)**: its rate and
timing parameters are left empty instead of being set to 0.

| Parameter | How it is calculated | What it says about the transporter |
|---|---|---|
| µmax (1/h) | Steepest straight stretch of log(OD) in a `r MU_WINDOW`-point window, extended to neighbouring windows within 95 % of that slope (`growthrates::fit_easylinear`, Hall *et al.* 2014) | Uptake capacity (Vmax) when transport limits growth |
| Time to OD `r GROWTH_OD` (h) | First time point with smoothed OD ≥ `r GROWTH_OD` | How soon growth starts; robust single number |
| Max OD | Highest smoothed OD | Whether the substrate is fully consumed and used efficiently |
| Decel. start OD | Smoothed OD where the growth rate falls below `r MU_FRACTION * 100` % of µmax after the exponential phase | Early slowdown at low substrate suggests low affinity (high Km) |
| AUC (OD x h) | Area under the measured, min-subtracted curve (trapezoid rule) | One number combining lag, rate and yield |
| yPet / OD | yPet fluorescence / final OD; growing wells only | Transporter expression per cell: if a poorly growing strain still expresses its transporter, poor growth comes from poor transport, not poor expression |

**yPet / OD** is in arbitrary units and comparable **only within a plate**
(see the plate warning above). Points to keep in mind:

- **EV is not a background control.** Its plasmid carries free (unfused) yPet,
  so where EV grew (ethanol) its yPet / OD is the expression of the plasmid
  without a transporter: a reference for the fusions, not something to
  subtract.
- **No background is subtracted.** The plates have no medium-only blanks. The
  lowest wells read about 15–300 a.u., small next to the thousands of
  growing wells.
- **Cell autofluorescence is included in every value.** Measuring it would
  need a strain without yPet (e.g. the host without plasmid) on each plate.
- **Final OD, not max OD:** the median of the last `r SMOOTH_K` readings of
  the run, the time closest to the fluorescence reading.
- **Fluorescence per OD falls as cultures get denser,** because dense cultures
  absorb and scatter part of the light. Compare strains that reached a similar
  OD. A dilution series of a few cultures would show how linear the reading is.
- **Expression is not localization.** Total fluorescence shows how much
  transporter the cells make, not whether it reaches the plasma membrane; that
  needs microscopy.

**Growth rates use only OD ≥ `r MU_MIN_OD`.** The first readings of the wells
scatter between about −0.1 and 0.5 around the true starting OD. On a log scale
that offset makes every curve look steepest just above the baseline, which
inflates µmax. Above OD `r MU_MIN_OD` the same offset changes log(OD) by only a
few percent. The appendix shows the µmax tangent of every well. Lag and
doubling time are not reported: lag needs the starting OD, which the
GrowthProfiler cannot measure reliably, and doubling time is just ln(2)/µmax.

```{r growth-parameters}
# Growth rate in each sliding window of MU_WINDOW points: slope of log(OD) vs
# time. OD below MU_MIN_OD is raised to MU_MIN_OD, so the baseline has slope 0.
mu_series <- function(time_h, od) {
  log_od      <- log(pmax(od, MU_MIN_OD))
  windows     <- map(seq_len(length(od) - MU_WINDOW + 1), ~ .x:(.x + MU_WINDOW - 1))
  window_time <- map_dbl(windows, ~ mean(time_h[.x]))
  window_mu   <- map_dbl(windows, ~ cov(time_h[.x], log_od[.x]) / var(time_h[.x]))
  tibble(time_h = window_time, mu = window_mu)
}

well_parameters <- function(well_data) {
  d      <- arrange(well_data, time_h)
  max_od <- max(d$OD_smooth)
  params <- tibble(grows = max_od >= GROWTH_OD, max_od = max_od,
                   auc =sum(diff(d$time_h) * (head(d$OD_bg, -1) + tail(d$OD_bg, -1)) / 2),
                   mu_max = NA_real_, time_to_od = NA_real_, decel_od = NA_real_,
                   y0_lm = NA_real_, fit_start = NA_real_, fit_end = NA_real_)
  if (!params$grows) return(params)

  params$time_to_od <- d$time_h[which(d$OD_smooth >= GROWTH_OD)[1]]

  # µmax and its tangent line (growthrates "easylinear")
  el     <- suppressWarnings(fit_easylinear(d$time_h, pmax(d$OD_smooth, MU_MIN_OD), h = MU_WINDOW))
  el_par <- coef(el)
  if (!is.finite(el_par[["mumax"]]) || el_par[["mumax"]] <= 0) return(params)

  # Deceleration: first window after the fastest one where the growth rate
  # drops below MU_FRACTION x µmax (NA if the well is still growing at the end)
  mu   <- mu_series(d$time_h, d$OD_smooth)
  fast <- mu$mu >= MU_FRACTION * el_par[["mumax"]]
  end  <- which.max(mu$mu)
  while (end < nrow(mu) && fast[end + 1]) end <- end + 1
  decel_time <- if (end < nrow(mu)) mu$time_h[end + 1] else NA_real_

  params %>% mutate(
    mu_max    = el_par[["mumax"]],
    decel_od  = if (is.na(decel_time)) NA_real_ else approx(d$time_h, d$OD_smooth, decel_time)$y,
    y0_lm     = el_par[["y0_lm"]],                 # tangent line, for the QC plots
    fit_start = d$time_h[min(el@ndx)],
    fit_end   = d$time_h[max(el@ndx)]
  )
}

growth_params <- growth_data_all %>%
  select(plate_id, well, time_h, OD_smooth, OD_bg) %>%
  nest(.by = c(plate_id, well), .key = "well_data") %>%
  mutate(params = map(well_data, well_parameters)) %>%
  select(-well_data) %>%
  unnest(params) %>%
  left_join(growthprofiler_md, by = c("plate_id", "well")) %>%
  mutate(plate = str_extract(plate_id, "MTP\\d+")) %>%
  relocate(plate_id, plate, well, host_strain, goi, substrate, concentration)

# yPet per OD: fluorescence / final OD, for growing wells only
growth_params <- growth_params %>%
  left_join(final_od, by = c("plate_id", "well")) %>%
  left_join(ypet_data, by = c("plate", "well")) %>%
  mutate(ypet_per_od = if_else(grows, ypet / final_od, NA_real_))

# Parameters in plot order, with labels and label precision
param_info <- tribble(
  ~param,        ~label,                                 ~digits,
  "mu_max",      "µmax (1/h)",                            2,
  "time_to_od",  paste0("Time to OD ", GROWTH_OD, " (h)"), 0,
  "max_od",      "Max OD",                                1,
  "decel_od",    "Decel. start OD",                       1,
  "auc",         "AUC (OD x h)",                          0,
  "ypet_per_od", "yPet / OD (a.u.)",                      0
)

# Mean ± SD per strain x condition. n = wells with a value; n_growing / n_wells
# tells whether all replicates grew.
param_summary <- growth_params %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(param_info$param), names_to = "param", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(host_strain, goi, substrate, concentration, plate, param) %>%
  summarise(n_wells = n(), n_growing = sum(grows), n = sum(!is.na(value)),
            mean = if (n > 0) mean(value, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
            sd   = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

dir.create(TABLE_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(select(growth_params, -c(y0_lm, fit_start, fit_end)),
          file.path(TABLE_DIR, "growth_parameters_per_well.csv"))
write_csv(param_summary, file.path(TABLE_DIR, "growth_parameters_summary.csv"))
```

# Results

## Growth calls

Number of replicate wells that reached OD `r GROWTH_OD`, per strain and
condition. EV (negative control) shows the background growth of the host;
growth above EV is enabled by the transporter.

```{r growth-calls, fig.width=11, fig.height=5.5}
# Tile layout shared by the growth calls and the overview heat maps:
# strains as rows, concentrations as columns, one block per substrate
tile_layout <- function(title) {
  list(facet_grid(~ substrate, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x"),
       scale_y_discrete(limits = rev, labels = goi_labels),
       labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL),
       theme_gp,
       theme(axis.line = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
             legend.position = "right", strip.background = element_blank(),
             strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")))
}

growth_calls <- growth_params %>%
  group_by(host_strain, goi, substrate, concentration) %>%
  summarise(n_grow = sum(grows), n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(goi = factor(goi, goi_levels),
         text_col = if_else(n_grow / n > 0.5, "white", "black"))

growth_call_plot <- function(strain) {
  ggplot(filter(growth_calls, host_strain == strain), aes(x = concentration, y = goi)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill = n_grow / n), color = "white", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n_grow, "/", n), color = text_col), size = 3.2) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey92", high = "#0072B2", limits = c(0, 1),
                        labels = scales::percent, name = "Wells grown") +
    scale_color_identity() +
    tile_layout(strain)
}

growth_call_page <- map(names(POSITIVE_CONTROL), growth_call_plot) %>%
  wrap_plots(ncol = 1, heights = map_int(names(POSITIVE_CONTROL), ~ length(host_gois(.x)))) +
  plot_annotation(title = paste("Growth calls: wells reaching OD", GROWTH_OD))

export_plots(list(growth_calls = growth_call_page), "growth_calls", height = 5.5)
growth_call_page
```

## Performance overview {.tabset .tabset-pills}

The three parameters that best separate the strains, per strain × condition.
Colours run from low (dark) to high (bright) for µmax and max OD, and from
slow (dark) to fast (bright) for time to OD `r GROWTH_OD`, so **bright is
always better**.

- **µmax and time to OD `r GROWTH_OD`:** mean of the growing wells. Grey =
  no growth; **\*** = not all replicate wells grew.
- **Max OD:** mean of all wells, so it also shows how little the
  non-growing strains grew.

```{r overview, fig.width=11, fig.height=8.5}
heat_plot <- function(strain, p) {
  info  <- filter(param_info, param == p)
  lower_is_better <- p == "time_to_od"
  d <- param_summary %>%
    filter(host_strain == strain, param == p) %>%
    mutate(goi   = factor(goi, goi_levels),
           label = case_when(n == 0 ~ "n.g.",
                             TRUE   ~ paste0(format(round(mean, info$digits), nsmall = info$digits),
                                             if_else(n < n_wells, "*", ""))),
           shade = scales::rescale(if (lower_is_better) -mean else mean),
           text_col = if_else(!is.na(shade) & shade < 0.5, "white", "black"))
  ggplot(d, aes(x = concentration, y = goi)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill = mean), color = "white", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label, color = text_col), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(direction = if (lower_is_better) -1 else 1,
                         na.value = "grey85", name = NULL) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    tile_layout(info$label)
}

overview_page <- function(strain) {
  map(c("mu_max", "time_to_od", "max_od"), ~ heat_plot(strain, .x)) %>%
    wrap_plots(ncol = 1) +
    plot_annotation(title = paste(strain, "- performance overview"),
                    subtitle = paste("µmax and time to OD: mean of growing wells (n.g. = no growth,",
                                     "* = not all replicates grew); max OD: mean of all wells"))
}

overview_pages <- map(names(POSITIVE_CONTROL), overview_page) %>%
  set_names(plot_name(names(POSITIVE_CONTROL)))

export_plots(overview_pages, "overview")
```

```{r overview-show, results='asis', echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=8.5}
show_plots(overview_pages)
```

## yPet expression on ethanol

On ethanol every strain grew to a similar OD, and all strains were on one
plate read with one gain, so this is the one condition where transporter
expression can be compared across all strains. EV carries free yPet from the
same plasmid, so its yPet / OD (dashed line) is the reference: the expression
of the plasmid without a transporter attached.

```{r ypet-ethanol, fig.width=11, fig.height=5}
ypet_ethanol <- growth_params %>%
  filter(substrate == "ethanol", !is.na(ypet)) %>%
  mutate(ratio = ypet / final_od, goi = factor(goi, goi_levels))

ypet_ethanol_sum <- ypet_ethanol %>%
  group_by(host_strain, goi) %>%
  summarise(final_od = mean(final_od), mean = mean(ratio), sd = sd(ratio), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(host_strain) %>%
  mutate(ev = mean[goi == "EV"], fold_ev = mean / ev) %>%
  ungroup()

ypet_ethanol_plot <- ggplot(ypet_ethanol_sum, aes(x = goi, y = mean, fill = goi)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), width = 0.25) +
  geom_point(data = ypet_ethanol, aes(y = ratio), shape = 21, fill = "white", size = 1.5,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, seed = 1)) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = ev), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  facet_grid(~ host_strain, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = goi_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = goi_labels) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(title = "yPet fluorescence per OD on ethanol 2% (one plate, one gain)",
       subtitle = "yPet / final OD; dashed line = EV (free yPet, no transporter)",
       x = NULL, y = "yPet / final OD (a.u.)") +
  theme_gp +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

export_plots(list(ypet_ethanol = ypet_ethanol_plot), "ypet_ethanol", height = 5)
ypet_ethanol_plot

ypet_ethanol_sum %>%
  transmute(host_strain, goi = goi_labels[as.character(goi)], final_od = round(final_od, 1),
            `yPet / OD` = paste(round(mean), "±", round(sd)), `x EV` = round(fold_ev, 2)) %>%
  kable(caption = "yPet per OD on ethanol, relative to EV")
```

Across the strains with a transporter, yPet / OD on ethanol is
**`r round(min(ypet_ethanol_sum$fold_ev[ypet_ethanol_sum$goi != "EV"]), 2)`–`r round(max(ypet_ethanol_sum$fold_ev[ypet_ethanol_sum$goi != "EV"]), 2)` × EV**.
Values around 1 mean the transporter fusion gives about as much fluorescence
per cell as free yPet from the same plasmid: the fusions are expressed, at
comparable levels. Two limits:

- **Autofluorescence is in every bar.** It pulls all values towards each
  other, so real differences may be larger than shown.
- **This is expression on ethanol only.** If the promoter responds to the
  carbon source, expression on the sugars can differ; the substrate pages
  show it per condition.

## Substrate pages {.tabset .tabset-pills}

One page per host strain × substrate, all strains side by side (EV,
transporters, positive control).

- **Six parameter panels:** bars = mean ± SD of the replicate wells, points =
  individual wells, **×** = no growth. The last panel is the transporter
  expression, yPet / final OD. EV carries free yPet, so where EV grew
  (ethanol) its bar is the plasmid's expression without a transporter.
- **Bottom row:** mean ± SD growth curves per concentration. The dotted line
  is OD `r GROWTH_OD`.
- A **plate warning** in the subtitle marks pages where the positive control
  was on a different plate.

```{r substrate-pages}
theme_page <- theme_pubr(base_size = 9)

# Same bar width and curve-panel width on every page
n_slots <- growth_params %>%
  distinct(host_strain, substrate, concentration) %>%
  count(host_strain, substrate) %>%
  pull(n) %>%
  max()

substrate_page <- function(strain, subs) {
  control <- POSITIVE_CONTROL[[strain]]
  gois    <- host_gois(strain)
  cols    <- goi_colors[gois]
  concs   <- sort(unique(growth_params$concentration[growth_params$host_strain == strain &
                                                     growth_params$substrate == subs]))
  slot_pad <- (n_slots - length(concs)) / 2 + 0.6

  wells <- growth_params %>%
    filter(host_strain == strain, substrate == subs) %>%
    mutate(goi = factor(goi, gois))
  sums  <- param_summary %>%
    filter(host_strain == strain, substrate == subs) %>%
    mutate(goi = factor(goi, gois),
           ng_y = if_else(n_growing == 0, 0, NA_real_))   # "no growth" cross (not for a value that is missing for other reasons)

  # Every layer keeps all strains (empty values are dropped only when drawn),
  # so points and crosses land on their own strain's bar
  dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.85)
  bar_panel <- function(p, title) {
    ggplot(filter(sums, param == p), aes(x = concentration, y = mean, fill = goi)) +
      geom_col(position = dodge, width = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd),
                    position = dodge, width = 0.3, linewidth = 0.3, na.rm = TRUE) +
      geom_point(data = wells, aes(y = .data[[p]], group = goi), position = dodge,
                 shape = 21, fill = "white", size = 0.8, stroke = 0.3, na.rm = TRUE) +
      geom_point(aes(y = ng_y, group = goi), position = dodge,
                 shape = 4, size = 1.2, na.rm = TRUE) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
      scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = slot_pad)) +
      scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
      expand_limits(y = 0) +
      labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
      guides(fill = "none") +          # colours are explained by the curve legend
      theme_page
  }
  bars <- map2(param_info$param, param_info$label, bar_panel)

  curve_data <- growth_data_mean %>%
    filter(host_strain == strain, substrate == subs) %>%
    mutate(goi = factor(goi, gois))
  y_max <- max(curve_data$mean_OD + curve_data$stdev_OD, na.rm = TRUE)
  curve_panel <- function(conc) {
    ggplot(filter(curve_data, concentration == conc),
           aes(x = time_h, y = mean_OD, color = goi, fill = goi)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_OD - stdev_OD, ymax = mean_OD + stdev_OD),
                  alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = GROWTH_OD, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40") +
      scale_color_manual(values = cols, labels = goi_labels, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = cols, labels = goi_labels, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_max)) +
      labs(title = conc, x = "Time (h)", y = "OD (smoothed)") +
      theme_page
  }
  curves <- c(map(concs, curve_panel),
              rep(list(plot_spacer()), n_slots - length(concs)))   # keep curves under their bar columns

  # Warn when the positive control was on another plate than the other strains
  plates      <- distinct(wells, goi, plate)
  ctrl_plate  <- sort(unique(plates$plate[plates$goi == control]))
  other_plate <- sort(unique(plates$plate[plates$goi != control]))
  plate_note  <- if (setequal(ctrl_plate, other_plate)) "" else
    paste0("\nPlate warning: ", control, " on ", paste(ctrl_plate, collapse = " + "),
           ", the other strains on ", paste(other_plate, collapse = " + "),
           ". Compare its growth with care and its yPet / OD not at all (different reader gain).")

  wrap_plots(c(bars, curves), ncol = 3, heights = c(1, 1, 1.3), guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(
      title    = paste(strain, "on", subs),
      subtitle = paste0("Mean ± SD of replicate wells, points = wells, x = no growth (OD < ",
                        GROWTH_OD, ")", plate_note),
      theme    = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"))) &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

substrate_index <- growth_params %>%
  distinct(host_strain, substrate) %>%
  arrange(host_strain, substrate)

# Laying out a multi-panel page is slow, so each page is laid out once (as a
# grob) and that grob is reused for the PDF, the SVG and the HTML
substrate_pages <- map2(substrate_index$host_strain, substrate_index$substrate, substrate_page) %>%
  map(patchworkGrob) %>%
  set_names(plot_name(substrate_index$host_strain, substrate_index$substrate))

export_plots(substrate_pages, "substrate_pages")
```

```{r substrate-pages-show, results='asis', echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=8.5}
show_plots(substrate_pages)
```

## Parameter table

Mean ± SD of the replicate wells; **n.g.** = no well grew. *Grown* = growing
wells / all wells. Also saved as `r TABLE_DIR`/growth_parameters_summary.csv
(and per well: growth_parameters_per_well.csv).

```{r parameter-table}
param_summary %>%
  mutate(value = case_when(n == 0 ~ "n.g.",
                           n == 1 ~ as.character(signif(mean, 3)),
                           TRUE   ~ paste(signif(mean, 3), "±", signif(sd, 2))),
         param = factor(param, param_info$param, param_info$label),
         grown = paste0(n_growing, "/", n_wells),
         goi   = factor(goi, goi_levels)) %>%
  select(host_strain, substrate, concentration, goi, plate, grown, param, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = param, values_from = value) %>%
  arrange(host_strain, substrate, concentration, goi)
```

# Appendix: quality check {.tabset .tabset-pills}

Every well of every condition on a **log scale**: points = raw OD, line =
smoothed OD, dashed = µmax tangent (a straight line on this scale is
exponential growth). The dotted line is OD `r MU_MIN_OD`; growth rates use only
the curve above it. Check here for artefacts (spikes, jumps, a replicate that
behaves differently) and that each tangent follows the steepest straight part
of its well. PDF only: `r FIG_DIR`/qc_wells.pdf.

```{r qc-wells}
qc_plot <- function(strain, subs, conc) {
  wells    <- growth_data_all %>%
    filter(host_strain == strain, substrate == subs, concentration == conc) %>%
    mutate(goi = factor(goi, host_gois(strain)))
  tangents <- growth_params %>%
    filter(host_strain == strain, substrate == subs, concentration == conc, !is.na(mu_max)) %>%
    mutate(goi = factor(goi, host_gois(strain)),
           t1 = fit_start - 5, t2 = fit_end + 5,
           y1 = y0_lm * exp(mu_max * t1), y2 = y0_lm * exp(mu_max * t2))
  ggplot(wells, aes(x = time_h, color = well)) +
    geom_point(aes(y = pmax(OD_gp, 0.01)), size = 0.3, alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_line(aes(y = pmax(OD_smooth, 0.01)), linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_segment(data = tangents, aes(x = t1, xend = t2, y = y1, yend = y2),
                 linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = MU_MIN_OD, linetype = "dotted") +
    scale_y_log10() +
    facet_wrap(~ goi, ncol = 3, labeller = as_labeller(goi_labels)) +
    force_panelsizes(cols = unit(2.6, "in"), rows = unit(2.6, "in")) +
    labs(x = "Time (h)", y = "OD (log scale)", color = "Well",
         title = paste("QC -", strain, subs, conc),
         subtitle = "Points: raw OD; line: smoothed OD; dashed: µmax tangent; dotted: lowest OD used for growth rates") +
    theme_gp +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
}

qc_index <- growth_params %>%
  distinct(host_strain, substrate, concentration) %>%
  arrange(host_strain, substrate, concentration)

qc_plots <- pmap(list(qc_index$host_strain, qc_index$substrate, qc_index$concentration), qc_plot) %>%
  set_names(plot_name(qc_index$host_strain, qc_index$substrate, qc_index$concentration))

export_plots(qc_plots, "qc_wells", svg = FALSE)
```

```{r qc-wells-show, results='asis', echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=8.5}
show_plots(qc_plots)
```
